blocks.html: Upon this, it is to be noted that there were three or four kinds of witnesses who came into consideration. The first, a maternal uncle of the said du Tilh, called Carbon Barrau, and thus beyond all suspicion; inasmuch as it is in no way probable that blood, in this case, would be willing to lie so far as, without any occasion, to procure the ignominious death of its own nephew.
